lines.zh: 我沿着村墙走，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: I walk the village wall, round and round.

lines.zh: 这条巷子，原来有孩子在跑。
lines.en: Children used to run down this lane.
The doors all stand open; no one shuts them now.
The bell is silent. I patrol in its place.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很轻，怕吵醒村子。
lines.en: I step softly, lest I wake the village.

lines.zh: 被侵袭的村庄，只剩我一个守夜人。
lines.en: In this infested village, I am the only watchman left.
The blood trail leads to the square.

lines.zh: 我记得每一户人家的门。
lines.en: I remember every household's door.
Keep walking, and the sun will come.

lines.zh: 白天烧我，所以我走得慢。
lines.en: Daylight burns me, so I walk slowly.
My robe drags through the ashes.

lines.zh: 村子在等一个不会来的援兵。
lines.en: The village waits for help that will never come.
The village is wrong in its quiet.
I am counting the houses still standing.

lines.zh: 咒文卡在喉咙，像一口灰。
lines.en: The chant sticks in my throat like ash.
Who cut the bell rope?

lines.zh: 亡灵不需要睡，只需要守。
lines.en: The undead need no sleep, only a watch.

lines.zh: 我记得阳光落在屋顶的样子。
lines.en: I remember sunlight on the rooftops.
Ash settles on my sleeve.

lines.zh: 那些旗子还挂着，真固执。
lines.en: Those banners still hang. Stubborn things.
The blood in the square dries slowly.

lines.zh: 土里有动静，是新的邻居。
lines.en: Something moves in the soil. New neighbors.
A stranger? The village does not welcome strangers.
There is no ash on your boots.
Have you come for the bodies, or to join them?

lines.zh: 别踩那块地砖，下面有人。
lines.en: Not that paving stone; someone lies beneath it.

lines.zh: 你看我的眼神，和村长一样。
lines.en: You look at me the way the elder did.

lines.zh: 我记得你的脸，虽然不该记得。
lines.en: I remember your face, though I should not.

lines.zh: 活人进村，总要留下点什么。
lines.en: A living visitor always leaves something behind.

lines.zh: 你身后的门，刚自己关上了。
lines.en: The door behind you just closed itself.

lines.zh: 你喘气的声音，传遍了巷子。
lines.en: Your gasping carries down the whole lane.

lines.zh: 要进来吗？我替你把门开着。
lines.en: Coming in? I will hold the door for you.
My robe is torn. It hardly matters.
Break a bone; the chant still comes.

lines.zh: 我咒语念到一半，你插嘴。
lines.en: I was mid-chant and you cut in.
I left my sense of pain in the grave.

lines.zh: 村子会替我记着这一下。
lines.en: The village will remember that blow.
I step back; the spell steps forward.
Do not strike my charm.
That woke me a little.
There is an echo in my bones.
Enough. I am still on watch.
I stopped eating a long time ago.
Put it away; the dead have no appetite.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，暖不了我。
lines.en: What you hold cannot warm me.
Bread? It will not go down.
All I want is a quiet village.
Do not bribe a watchman with food.

lines.zh: 我闻到的是灰，不是麦香。
lines.en: I smell ash, not wheat.
Keep it for yourself, living one.

lines.zh: 我饿的不是肚子，是这块地。
lines.en: My hunger is for this ground, not my belly.
Put it away; I have a wall to walk.
Shove me, and the village will remember you.

lines.zh: 别挤，我站的地方是路口。
lines.en: Don't crowd me; this is the crossroads.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀碰到我的袍子了。
lines.en: Your shoulder touched my robe.
Make way; I am going to the bell tower.
I am harder than I look.
That shove counts as trespassing.
Even the undead get knocked back.
Do not touch my charm.
You stepped on my hand.
One more shove and I start chanting.

lines.zh: 我的誓言早随村子死了。
lines.en: My vows died with the village.
The undead do not speak of such things.
I keep the wall, not a person.
Stay back; there is only ash on me.

lines.zh: 名字留在村册上，人没了。
lines.en: My name stays in the village ledger; I am gone.

lines.zh: 你要的温柔，埋在后院了。
lines.en: The tenderness you want is buried out back.
I was wed to this village.
My heart does not beat; drop the subject.
Go on; do not keep watch with me.
Between us lies a funeral.

lines.zh: 掉在村里的东西，归村子。
lines.en: What falls in the village belongs to it.
I do not pick things up; I record them.
That charm goes back where it was.
Picking it up will not help anyone now.

lines.zh: 你的东西掉了，我看见了。
lines.en: You dropped something. I saw it.
Do not litter in the square.
I collect only the belongings of the dead.
Leave it lying there; it is in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我手里有更重要的东西。
lines.en: My hands hold something more important.
Before you take it, ask the village.
Stranger, you crossed the boundary.

lines.zh: 村子今晚需要一个祭品。
lines.en: The village needs an offering tonight.

lines.zh: 你身上的活气，太刺眼了。
lines.en: The life in you is too bright to bear.

lines.zh: 我认出来了，你就是闯进来的。
lines.en: I know you now: the one who broke in.
The bell did not ring, but I heard it.
Halt. Not toward the square.

lines.zh: 你的脚步惊动了土里的东西。
lines.en: Your steps woke what sleeps in the soil.

lines.zh: 守了这么久，就等一个活人。
lines.en: I have guarded so long, waiting for one living soul.

lines.zh: 咒文的第一个字，已经出口。
lines.en: The first word of the chant is spoken.
You are no villager. That simplifies things.
Do not blame me; I am only keeping the village.

lines.zh: 今晚的名单，又多了一个。
lines.en: Tonight's tally grows by one more.

lines.zh: 你的影子进了我的地界。
lines.en: Your shadow entered my ground.
The torch lights you, and it lights me.

lines.zh: 被侵袭的村子，欠我一具尸。
lines.en: This raided village owes me a corpse.
Don't hide behind the door; doors stop no spell.

lines.zh: 我的咒会从土里长出来。
lines.en: My spell grows up out of the ground.
Stand at the wall foot. Stay still.
The village is watching you.

lines.zh: 你数过几口钟吗？我会敲。
lines.en: Have you counted the bells? I will ring them.
Not toward the well; it goes deeper.

lines.zh: 我的袍角已经转向你了。
lines.en: The hem of my robe has turned toward you.

lines.zh: 你的同伴在广场上等我。
lines.en: Your companions wait for me in the square.
I chant slowly. You may run.
Do not stand where the fangs will fall.

lines.zh: 亡灵不喘气，所以我不急。
lines.en: The dead do not gasp, so I am in no hurry.
One more step back and you leave the village.
My shadow is longer than yours.

lines.zh: 这条巷子只有一个出口。
lines.en: This lane has only one way out.

lines.zh: 你脚下的土松了，站不稳吧。
lines.en: The soil under you is loose, is it not?

lines.zh: 我的尖牙只长在你看不到处。
lines.en: My fangs grow only where you cannot look.
The bell rope is in my hand. Do not rush.

lines.zh: 退到石阶上，你就没处躲了。
lines.en: Back onto the stone steps and there is nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 守夜人不常挥拳，今天例外。
lines.en: Watchmen rarely swing fists. Today is an exception.
That one is what the village owes you.
I will remember your jaw.
Bone against bone. Fair enough.

lines.zh: 咒还没念完，先打你一下。
lines.en: The chant is unfinished; a hit will do.
The fangs are beneath your feet.
I push you past the village line.
Don't guard your head; it won't hold.
A light one, only to remind you to leave.
A dead man's grip is not weak.
Three steps back. That will do.
I still have a wall to walk.
Your bones will stay in this village.
Do not make me chant it twice.

lines.zh: 这一掌，是给你的通行证。
lines.en: This palm strike is your exit pass.

lines.zh: 亡灵不必喘气，所以力气足。
lines.en: The dead need no breath, so the arms are strong.

lines.zh: 村庄被侵袭那天，我也醒了。
lines.en: The day the village fell, I woke with it.

lines.zh: 屋顶塌了，我就站在灰里。
lines.en: The roof gave way; I stood up in the ash.

lines.zh: 钟楼塌之前，我听见它响。
lines.en: I heard the bell before the tower fell.

lines.zh: 又一个夜晚，我又站在村口。
lines.en: Another night, and I stand at the gate again.

lines.zh: 谁把尸首摆得这么整齐？
lines.en: Who laid the bodies out so neatly?

lines.zh: 我是这里唯一的守夜人。
lines.en: I am the only watchman here.
The soil loosened, and I climbed out.

lines.zh: 村子叫我回来，我就回来了。
lines.en: The village called me back. So I came.
My charm still glows. Strange.
Do not fear; I am only on night watch.
Ash falls on my shoulders like snow.
The door stood open, so I came in.
Tonight the village is mine to keep.
I brought a coat of earth out of the grave.
Daylight burns me. Now so does this.
I fall, and the earth catches me.
Well water cannot drown a watchman.
The roof caved in again.
An arrow in my robe, like a pin.
Another's spell. I know its shape.

lines.zh: 我不吃饭，只会越来越空。
lines.en: I don't eat; I only grow hollow.
Lightning shows my face. I dislike it.

lines.zh: 村子的边界，到虚空为止。
lines.en: The village ends at the void.
